summary.headline: Effects of Planetary Conjunctions
summary.text: Astrological effects of conjunctions and eclipses according to the signs: fixed signs prolong evil, movable signs lessen its duration, and common signs produce moderate effects. The greatest conjunction of the superior planets, especially in one term or face and aspected by the Sun, signifies upheavals of sects and kingdoms, prophets, wars, miracles, sterility, dryness, and famine.
